name: Shrutilipi
description: Large-scale labeled ASR corpus from All India Radio news bulletins. 6,400+ hours across 12 Indian languages.
vaaksetu_use: Train speech recognition for voice input commands in rural Indian accents

name: IndicVoices
description: Large-scale multilingual speech dataset with diverse speakers, including rural and low-resource accents.
vaaksetu_use: Improve recognition of rural accent voice commands when scanning documents

name: Rasa
description: Expressive multilingual TTS training dataset. Used to train AI4Bharat's Indic Parler-TTS model.
vaaksetu_use: Foundation for the AI4Bharat TTS voice that reads legal warnings aloud in native Indian languages

name: Samanantar
description: Largest publicly available parallel corpus for Indian languages. 49.7M English-to-Indic sentence pairs.
vaaksetu_use: Translate legal clause explanations between Indian languages accurately

name: Aksharantar
description: 26M+ pairs for Roman-to-Native script transliteration across 21 Indian languages.
vaaksetu_use: Handle mixed-script OCR output where Hindi words appear in Roman script (Hinglish)

name: Naamapadam
description: Large-scale NER dataset for 11 Indian languages with 400K+ annotated sentences.
vaaksetu_use: Extract party names, land survey numbers, and financial amounts from legal documents

name: IndicOCR
description: Printed text recognition dataset across 13 Indic scripts. Used for training and benchmarking OCR models.
vaaksetu_use: Fine-tune OCR model for stamp papers, printed deeds, and registration certificates

name: Indic Parler-TTS Model
description: Multilingual, expressive TTS model for 23+ Indian languages. Natural and controllable speech synthesis.
vaaksetu_use: PRIMARY TTS ENGINE — replaces flutter_tts device speech with high-quality native Indian TTS

name: BhasaAnuvaad
description: Massive speech translation dataset. 44,400 hours across 13 Indian languages.
vaaksetu_use: Future: Directly translate scanned document audio between Indian languages
